Drinks with friends.
Jan 2020 • Friends
Visited Ned Kelly's on Chinese New Year's Eve. 
The Manager Dave Stevens gave a warm hearty welcome to everyone entering the establishment. 

A true host. If your with friends or alone. Before you left your circle of friends had grown. 

The beer is cold. The food is excellent..The atmosphere warm & inviting. 
If it's your first visit to Vung Tau. Ned Kelly's is a go to place. 

Dave Stevens is the go to guy for food. Drinks & information or just a chat.
